visual_method.method: Anchored review with an explicit defect ledger and matched native states; not a functional-pass-to-beauty conversion.

Alignment: Paired controls and reading columns share their intended axes.
Native button ink has no unexplained visible offset; both axes are measured.
Headers, values and controls retain alignment across matched states.
Spacing: Peer controls have equal gutters within one device pixel.
Functional groups use a consistent spacing rhythm.
No accidental reserved-height bands or clipping appear in the evaluated views.
Icon quality: One pinned vector family with consistent optical weight.
Symbols match the action and transport symbols remain recognizable.
Icons and labels form balanced groups at actual review scale.
Borders and surfaces: Surfaces distinguish grouping, actions, selection and numeric entry.
Focus/danger outlines have a consistent purpose; no accidental double edges.
Primary actions and disabled controls do not impersonate status readings.
Type hierarchy: Page titles, control labels, captions and primary readings have stable roles.
Long filenames and units retain an intelligible hierarchy.
The primary task reading remains stronger than secondary settings.
Legibility: Active text meets 4.5:1 contrast, or 3:1 for large text.
Essential values and units remain visible without truncation.
Native captures are examined at full resolution and the user's landscape review scale.
Functional grouping: Position, distance and speed remain related to their axis.
Filament temperature is visible or explicit before Load/Unload starts.
Job identity, progress, ETA and job controls form a coherent task.
Density and restraint: Secondary choices are disclosed in context rather than forming an unrelated button grid.
Space supports a task or hierarchy; adding controls is not rewarded by itself.
Touch geometry: Visible and actual targets agree and retain at least 48 dp.
Spatial controls respond across their intended regions and a drag does not actuate.
E-stop stays reachable while a numeric editor is open.
Interaction clarity: Editable values and selections are recognizable.
Multi-digit replacement, decimal entry, deletion and Cancel behave as shown.
A user can distinguish a proposed value from a committed actuator target.
State consistency: Readings, labels and control states agree with the simulated printer state.
Pending, cancelled, paused, completed and shutdown states remain truthful.
No duplicate/conflicting progress or obsolete state icon remains.
Cross-screen finish: Shared components retain the same hierarchy, geometry and meanings.
Dialogs name the controlled object and unit, with a consistent escape.
Main and secondary views receive matched visual inspection, not only Home.

visual_method.scoring: Record a specific visible reference advantage and open defects for each score above 8. Use defect severity to distinguish candidates; do not award feature-count points. An unexamined criterion cannot be marked passed.
visual_method.calibration: Historical 0.3.8 estimates are not ground truth. New evidence may lower a rating. Supplemental references are examples, unscored, and do not replace Bambu.
visual_method.precision: A criterion score states conformance to this frozen review, not universal aesthetic quality. Retain residual uncertainty and original visual target separately from measured task scores.
visual_method.capture_context: New capture runs initialize filament target 200 C, XY/Z/E distance 10/0.1/5 mm and feed rates 20/5/3 mm/s through native controls. Paused-job context is initialized explicitly. Custom-context captures are marked in their manifest. Reset transient navigation/calibration-result context by relaunching with the explicit debug loopback endpoint before initialization. Retained custom contexts are marked.

actuation_method.environment: Already-open emulator-5554 on verified loopback Moonraker fixture; no physical printer.
actuation_method.counting: Count each tap, digit, correction, gesture and required confirmation. Setup/cleanup are excluded. Record exact requests and outcomes. Baseline Clear is counted only where the selected-range defect makes it necessary.
actuation_method.efficiency: 10 * mean(min(1, frozen input_budget / observed input_count)). Never remove a necessary confirmation to improve cost.
actuation_method.fidelity: 10 * fraction of verified intent/command checks. Any wrong or unintended actuation blocks acceptance.
actuation_method.context: 10 * fraction of pinned contextual checks: heater identity/unit, cancelled edit emits no command, Cancel returns to its parameter context, numeric selection replacement works.
actuation_method.interruption: 10 * fraction of pinned checks: Load cancel restores owned target without extrusion; Unload cancel likewise; paused change resumes same job; E-stop acts from numeric modal.
actuation_method.latency: Record automated durations separately. They include tool/snapshot overhead and are not human task times.
actuation_method.discoverability: Label-guided automation does not measure first-use discovery; report that limitation.
actuation_method.acceptance: Actuation failures cannot be averaged away by visual scores or efficient tasks. These additional scores cannot substitute for the ten original visual categories.

animation_method.reason: The fixed Bambu images are static; do not invent a motion score for them.
criteria: Touch feedback begins promptly without delaying or duplicating an actuation.
Page and dialog transitions have consistent, restrained timing and stable hit geometry.
Live readings remain truthful; animate a progress change rather than inventing intermediate temperatures.
Repeated navigation or dismissal cancels obsolete motion and leaves the latest destination correct.
System reduced-motion settings produce the final state immediately.
Record actual normal/reduced-motion clips, action markers and renderer timings per candidate.
Compare performance only under matched renderer/device conditions; keep emulator graphics faults separate from app changes.
evidence: Per-action frame timing data with scope/limitations
Actuation traces, including interruption and E-stop
animation_method.style: Functional standard motion, with no bounce or moving motor-control targets.
animation_method.acceptance: An additional improvement criterion; it cannot substitute for the ten original visual categories.
